cinematic.desc: Only calm scenic or graphics-showcase shots with no action and little speech (sunsets, city views, detail close-ups). Square gameplay on a dark blurred fill, teal-orange grade, grain, slow push-in

hype.desc: Default for anything with action or gameplay: chases, fights, robberies, fails, crashes, chaos, funny gameplay. Tall 4:5 gameplay crop that fills most of the screen and follows the action, big captions with yellow highlight

split_live.desc: Streamer visibly talking or reacting to what is on screen (shocked, laughing, explaining, hyping). Needs a facecam with a clear reaction. Facecam on top, gameplay below, hook line on the seam for the first 3 s, sentence-case word captions

split_meme.desc: The streamer's face IS the joke: a big, obvious facial reaction (jaw drop, crying laughing, rage). Needs a facecam with a strong visible reaction. Big facecam on top, one short all-caps meme line on the seam, no word captions
